- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Both the Merrell Moab 2 Mid Waterproof and the Keen Targhee II Mid WP are mid-cut, waterproof hiking boots with a breathable membrane.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Both hiking boots have a rugged outsole with a good tread pattern for traction and stability.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Both boots are suitable for day hikes, backpacking, and general outdoor activities.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Merrell boots are known for their comfortable, snug fit, while Keen boots tend to have a roomier toe box.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Merrell Moab 2 Mid Waterproof is slightly lighter at 1.5 lbs compared to 1.7 lbs for the Keen Targhee II Mid WP.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Merrell Moab 2 has a more substantial ankle collar for additional support, while the Keen Targhee II has a more flexible ankle design.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Merrell boots are known for being comfortable right out of the box, while Keen boots might require a longer break-in period.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Keen Targhee II Mid WP is generally priced lower than the Merrell Moab 2 Mid Waterproof.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] User should consider personal preferences, hiking style, and terrain when deciding between the two boots.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested outdoor gear stores include REI, Dick's Sporting Goods, Cabela's, and local outdoor gear stores.
